title: Six-Type Question Candidates, Coherent Groups, and Bounded Selection

T09-01.name: Six-type candidate generation, defensive schema validation, options labels (A-D) & cardinality

T09-02.name: Completion and short answer word count boundaries (<= 3 words valid, 4 words rejected, exact span)

T09-03.name: Multiple choice distractor quality, duplicate option text rejection, and answer collision defense

T09-04.name: Summary completion group coherence, shared summary draft, numbered blanks, and dynamic group invalidation

T09-05.name: Joint group constraints and anti-redundancy (duplicate evidence fact rejection across questions)

T09-06.name: Bounded search caps, finite pool limits from Settings, and typed SelectionInfeasibleError escalation

T09-07.name: Authoritative persistence, BoundedLoopRuntime group composition, and crash resumption
T09-07.notes: Post-commit idempotent replay (zero call/token/wall delta, deadline preserved), head hash immutability, 4-window crash resumption, actual-loop mid-flight Q17 crash resumption, and safe failure lifecycle reconciliation verified across SQLite and real PostgreSQL (port 5099, exam_test_phase09).

T09-08.name: Deterministic tie-breaking on (-score, candidate_id) and candidate selection composition

conclusion: Phase 09 candidate generation components (P09-01 through P09-10) are fully implemented and verified. All required T09 tests (T09-01 through T09-08 plus T09-09/T09-10) and 10 real PostgreSQL durability scenarios pass cleanly. Candidate evaluations execute as runtime-owned BoundedLoopRuntime state transitions under a reserved workflow parent operation with safe failure lifecycle reconciliation and bounded retry accounting proven. Real PostgreSQL durability, post-commit idempotent replay accounting, Scenario 8 subprocess crash resumption without finally cleanup, Scenario 9 hard deadline enforcement with zero replay call/token delta, and Scenario 10 .NET worker consumer group mapping are verified on port 5099 with zero counter inflation. All upstream gates G07 and G08 are verified PASS. Gate G09 is formally PASSED.
